distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide baseline records from Hunan, Guangdong, Sichuan, Yunnan, Anhui, Fujian, Hainan, Xizang and Taiwan. Smith et al. (2020) confirms several of these and adds Chongqing, Gansu, Guizhou, Hong Kong, Hubei, Jiangsu and Jiangxi. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: The baseline host set from 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) is retained. Smith et al. (2020) provides no host value in the promoted record. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes broad polyphagy and explicitly includes Brownea sp.; Brownea sp. is added at the reported genus resolution, while the non-enumerated broad host statement remains contextual.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea interjectus (Blandford, 1894).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus pseudovalidus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 159.

taxonomic_history.name: Euwallacea interjectus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Xyleborus interjectus; 黄复生等 (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) use Euwallacea interjectus. Beaver & Liu (2010) records a TARI specimen formerly labelled Xyleborus validus that was reidentified as E. interjectus. Canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Blandford, 1894), VSN_2699.
